summary.text: John Day is a Democratic candidate on the ballot for Louisiana's 3rd Congressional District.

paragraphs.text: Born in Shreveport, raised in Lake Charles, and graduated from Sam Houston High School, according to his Ballotpedia survey.
Served in the U.S. Navy beginning in 1994.
Works as a professional writer and, in his words, is working toward producing film projects.
Says he is married to Amanda Hardy Day and that they have four grown children.
